d: The Technical Instructor/Assessor is responsible for delivery of Technical Training to students within the BAE Systems Technical Institute in Doha, Qatar.

The Technical Instructor/Assessor will deliver a range of training modules, across the Mechanical and Electrical General Engineering programme. The successful delivery of the modules will contribute toward the learner’s attainment of externally accredited qualifications.

The Technical Instructor/Assessor will assess learner performance, in accordance with the assessment strategy in force for the modules. Assessment of learners may take place from within or outside of their trade boundary, to allow for independence.
The Technical Instructor/Assessor will actively contribute to the continuing improvement of the QTI, through identification of ideas and embracing the suggestions of others.
The roles will deliver Aerospace Mechanical and Electrical General Engineering to QAF students within the TI, both in the classroom and the workshops.
The roles will utilize both presentation media and training devices and assets to deliver training and the instructor must be proficient in all methods.
The roles will conduct assessment of the learners, either through practical or knowledge-based testing, in accordance with the assessment strategy in place.
q: Level 4 Qualification in Teaching & learning (including 90 hrs teaching practice)
5yrs training delivery experience gained outside of the TI (or 2yrs within) delivering:
2yrs experience in training design following BSAT/DSAT model
r: Responsible for the delivery of the basic and specialty engineering programmes within the TI ensuring training is delivered to plan and quality.
Establish and maintain effective links with local QEAF Cadet Welfare teams to ensure their support is forthcoming to cadet welfare and discipline issues.
Maintain and develop a customer focused approach that delivers customer satisfaction.
Ensure all SHE requirements are met in the training environment.
Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory and corporate requirements.

d: The Logistics Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and optimizing daily transportation and logistics operations. This role focuses on fleet management, trucks sourcing from suppliers, route planning, driver coordination, timely cargo delivery, cost control, and full compliance with local Saudi transport regulations (TGA / Wasl).

The Logistics Supervisor plans, coordinates, and directs transport and logistics services to ensure efficient, safe, and cost-effective operations. The role involves managing fleet dispatching, optimizing haulage routes, tracking delivery performance, and coordinating with clients and internal teams to meet service level agreements (SLAs) while adhering to regulatory and safety standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree preferably in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Business Administration, or a related field.
5–8+ years of proven experience in logistics and transport operations management.
Strong knowledge of Saudi Transport General Authority (TGA) regulations and local traffic laws.
Hands-on experience with Fleet Management Systems (FMS), Transport Management Systems (TMS), and GPS tracking tools.
Excellent leadership, problem-solving, communication, and reporting skills.
r: Oversee day-to-day transport activities, cargo movement, and delivery schedules.
Manage and optimize fleet utilization, vehicle assignment, and route planning to minimize delivery delays and fuel costs.
Monitor vehicle tracking systems (Wasl platform / GPS) to ensure real-time visibility of shipments and driver compliance.
Ensure strict compliance with Saudi Transport General Authority (TGA) rules, operating cards, and vehicle inspection regulations.
Manage truck entry/permit timings according to local traffic authorities' restrictions across Saudi regions.
Oversee safety compliance, driver safety protocols, and health, safety, and environment (HSE) standards.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as on-time delivery (OTD), fleet maintenance costs, and turnaround times.
Optimize operational expenses, fuel consumption, and cargo distribution efficiency.
Address operational bottlenecks, delays, or emergency vehicle breakdowns promptly.
Serve as the primary contact for client logistical inquiries, custom clearances, and delivery updates.
Coordinate with warehouse managers, dispatchers, and external vendors to maintain seamless supply chain operations.
Handle client complaints or transport issues and implement effective corrective actions.
Lead, schedule, and evaluate transport supervisors, dispatchers, and drivers.
Prepare weekly and monthly logistics performance reports, operational risk assessments, and executive summaries for senior management.

d: Deploy and implement asset-based process safety, loss prevention and risk engineering objectives, providing critical inputs and facilitation to ensure compliance with relevant standards. Deliver appropriate advisory to asset(s) and relevant customers in advancing excellence in process safety and risk engineering, including across associated assets/facilities, brownfield projects and interfacing major capital projects.
Execute the deployment and implementation of company process safety, loss prevention and risk management objectives and program in the assigned asset(s).
Provide process safety and risk engineering inputs and review for engineering documentations, project deliverables, interface documents to ensure they meet with the relevant standards.
Facilitate the hazard identification (HAZID) and risk assessment studies and prepare related reports.
Facilitate the implementation of relevant loss prevention engineering procedures in the assigned asset(s).

Conduct and support the execution of major safety studies such as quantitative risk assessment (QRA), and manage asset hazard and operability (HAZOP), safety and integrity level (SIL) baseline/revalidation etc., coordinating activities required for the completion of those studies. Work with external consultant to produce quality document as required. Collaborate with QatarEnergy LNG Assets and other functional groups to ensure adequate involvement.
Coordinate Safety Case and Barrier Management efforts in the assigned asset(s) to facilitate the identification, implementation, and maintenance of effective safety barriers.

Perform safety and technical review of Management of Change requests (MOCs) and consult with assigned engineers and the functional groups to ensure that plant/field integrity and safety is maintained.

Monitor and analyse key process safety performance indicator, identifying trends and providing insights in process safety performance, collaborating with Operations and other relevant departments to initiate corrective actions.

Provide the required support for the administration, implementation, and sustainability of L3 Manage Operations Risk (MOR) Process and L3 Ensure Process Safety across QatarEnergy LNG in their respective assets.
Represent Process Safety & Risk Engineering in the projects for safety studies including, HAZOP, HAZID, 3D model review, SIL review, QRA, etc. relevant to the assigned asset(s).
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably in chemical, mechanical or safety).
8 years’ experience in oil and gas sector in process safety, loss prevention, risk management and technical safety areas
Experience in process safety, and risk assessment/studies.
Require lead hazard identification reviews utilizing recognized techniques (e.g., HAZOP, What-If, etc.) with a good understanding of qualitative and quantitative risk assessment techniques.
Practical knowledge of safe systems of work with emergency preparedness knowledge/experience.
